title: Transfer from nondeterministic to banked preconditions
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register program with $m$ registers and $d$ oracle deciders, let $M_j$ decide a language $L_j$ in space $s_j$ for each $j$, and fix an input bit string $x$. Suppose $B,W_d\in\mathbb N$, $1\le B$, and for every $j,n$ with $n\le 2|x|+2+m(2W_d+2)$ we have $s_j(n)\le B$. If a configuration $a$ satisfies the nondeterministic precondition for $A$ on $x$, and every register value $v(r)$ in $a$ has binary representation of length at most $W_d$ after adding $1$, then $a$ satisfies the corresponding precondition for the banked machine that simulates all the deciders, using the language indicators as its oracles and space bound $B$.
